clue.text: Brexit clearly just a slight majority, grappling with possibility of disentanglement

definitions.note: the clue phrase stands for the quality of being freeable, an adjective in the answer

indicators.note: grappling suggests wrestling and twisting, so the letters are tangled into a new order
a slight majority of the seven letters of clearly is its first four

explanation.surface: A commentator notes the narrow Leave win while wondering whether Britain can ever untangle itself from Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'just a slight majority' keeps CLEA, four of the seven letters of 'clearly', echoing the 52-48 result; 'grappling with' shuffles BREXIT with CLEA.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that can be freed from a tangle or difficulty has that possibility built in, which is what this adjective describes.

clue.text: Initially eluding staff, captive gorilla perhaps making getaway

definitions.note: the phrase works as a verb, to flee

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of each of the next three words

parts.note: a gorilla is one example of an ape

explanation.surface: A zoo gorilla dodges its keepers and breaks out of its enclosure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Initially' governs three words, eluding, staff and captive, giving ESC; 'perhaps' marks gorilla as just one kind of ape.
explanation.definitionFit: To flee from confinement is to make a getaway, the everyday meaning of breaking free.

clue.text: Candidate getting in front in Iowa, that man had won

explanation.walkthrough: 'Candidate' is Donald Trump, running for US president in 2016; 'getting in' puts the Iowa letter inside his name.
explanation.definitionFit: Having won is having prevailed or come out victorious, a direct synonym in the past tense.

clue.text: Iceland getting two, dominating no-good wingers — English hopeless!

definitions.note: the phrase means utterly without hope, an adjectival phrase

parts.note: a pair is two of something

explanation.walkthrough: 'dominating' makes the Iceland code wrap the rest. Iceland famously knocked England out of football's Euro 2016 by two goals to one.
explanation.definitionFit: Being without hope is the state of despair, so the phrase serves as an adjective meaning hopeless.

clue.text: Reverse decision on a ship's chosen name (in part), changing answer to be acceptable to higher echelons

explanation.walkthrough: Boaty McBoatface won a 2016 public vote, but the ship was named after Sir David Attenborough; 'changing' swaps answer for upper-class in the name's tail.

clue.text: Football's surprise package, i.e. secret flash of Lineker's pants

explanation.walkthrough: Gary Lineker vowed to present Match of the Day in his underpants if Leicester won the league, and did so in 2016.
explanation.definitionFit: The club's 5000-1 Premier League title in 2016 was the biggest shock in English football, a true surprise package.

clue.text: Society losing leader of longevity's a Caribbean nation

clue.text: Remove upper limit on University's capacity to collect money, essentially

clue.text: Instantly combustible phone? True
